title: RaceChrono Lap Session Lap Time Leaderboard
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=racechrono:lap lap_time_seconds=*
| stats sum(lap_time_seconds) as total_value, avg(lap_time_seconds) as avg_value by track_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks track name values by total and average lap time across RaceChrono lap session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `lap_time_seconds` values for each RaceChrono lap session event and review total and average lap time by track name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total lap time.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which track name shows the biggest lap time numbers in your RaceChrono lap session data.
